info.name: ComicMaintainer API
info.description:
Requests for every route of the ComicMaintainer API. docs/API.md describes the routes and docs/POSTMAN_API_COLLECTION.md describes this collection.

Sign in with Auth > Login. It saves a session token to jwt_token, and the collection sends that as a bearer token. The OPDS folder uses HTTP Basic instead, and the event stream uses a single-use stream token.

item.name: Auth

request.description: Whether first-run setup is available.
Creates the first administrator of a new instance. setup_token is the code printed in the server log at startup, or SETUP_TOKEN. Answers 403 when setup is not available or the code is wrong.
Signs in and saves the session token to jwt_token. Limited to 10 attempts per 5 minutes per client address.
Creates an account with the User role. Administrators only: sign in as one first. Anyone else gets 401 or 403. Kept for scripts: Users > Create User also sets the role.
Changes the password, ends every session and revokes the API key. Saves the new session token.
Creates or replaces the API key and saves it to api_key. It is shown only once. Needs the current password, except under Authelia.
Gets a single-use, 60 second token for Events > Event Stream.
Ends this session. With allSessions, ends every session and revokes the API key.

item.description: Sign-in, API keys and stream tokens.

item.name: Users

request.description: Every account, sorted by username, and whether Authelia is enabled. Saves the first account that is not yours to user_id.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const other = pm.response.json().users.find(u => !u.isCurrentUser); if (other) { pm.environment.set('user_id', other.id); } }

request.description: Creates an account with a role: Admin, User or ReadOnly. Answers 201 and saves the new account to user_id. Needs your own password, except under Authelia, where creating accounts is refused (409).
Gives the account one role and ends its sessions. Needs your own password. Refused (409) for your own account, the last active administrator, and under Authelia.
Sets the password, ends every session, revokes the API key and lifts a lockout. Needs your own password. Refused (409) for your own account and under Authelia.
Disables the account, ends its sessions and revokes its API key. No password needed. Refused (409) for your own account and the last active administrator.
Lets a disabled account sign in again. Needs your own password, except under Authelia.

Deletes the account with its reading progress, read status, preferences, e-reader devices, subscriptions and delivery history. Answers 204. Refused (409) for your own account and the last active administrator.

item.description: Administrator only. Account administration, as on the Users page.

request.description: filter: marked, unmarked, duplicates, renamed, normalized, read, unread. sort: name, date, size. per_page=-1 returns everything.
Merges: fields left out or null keep their value.

scope is library, series or folder; the last two need id.
Optional fields lists what to apply; a listed field with no value is removed.
